assumptions: Fetch follow-up allowance = ceil(turns*arms*reps*68/801): 68 kind=='tool-followup' rows vs 801 kind=='turn' rows in experiments/ptr-engine/measure/rows-*.jsonl; the ledger bills a follow-up (rule 2). Overridable with --fetch-followup-allowance.

--hypothesis defaults to PARM-1's primary (H2) rather than being a mandatory flag, because tests/test_projection_calibration.py (checks a, c) and tests/test_guards.py (d) drive LIVE paths without it and assert the runner is reached; those files are other cards' write paths and were not edited. An explicit 'none' is refused (exit 2) and the default is recorded as hypothesis_source=default:PARM-1.primary, so the choice is auditable rather than implied.

Exit codes 5 and 6 were grade/analyse and were renumbered to 10/11 so that 5=runner crash and 6=runaway abort (run_longrun.py's own distinct codes) are propagated instead of collapsed; consistency keeps 9. No guard was weakened.
